description: Sri Lanka Tourism - Tourism Act No 38 of 2005 order Under Section 53
categorisation: The gazette content is an order issued under the Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005, specifically revoking three previous orders. It is a legal/regulatory instrument made under existing legislation, focusing on the amendment of subsidiary regulations. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized category better than Legal/Regulatory.
